name: vscode-codex-pet
description: A sprite-sheet pet that walks around a VS Code panel, similar to vscode-pets.

commands.title: Codex Pet: Install Claude Code Hooks...

enumDescriptions: Show the pet in the bottom panel, alongside Terminal/Output.
Show the pet in the Activity Bar side panel, alongside Explorer/Git.
Show the pet in both locations at once (each runs independently).
codexPet.location.description: Where the Codex Pet view is shown.

codexPet.selectedPet.description: Pet id or folder name under pets/ to load. Leave empty to use the last pet picked via "Codex Pet: Choose Pet..." (or the only pet, if just one exists).

codexPet.walkSpeed.description: Pixels per second the pet moves while running/walking.

codexPet.moveChance.description: Probability the pet starts moving (vs. playing a stationary animation) at the start of each action cycle.

codexPet.minActionDuration.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between actions: how long the pet stays in one action (moving or stationary) before picking a new one.

codexPet.maxActionDuration.description: Maximum delay in milliseconds between actions: how long the pet stays in one action (moving or stationary) before picking a new one.

codexPet.idleAnimationSpeed.description: Speed multiplier for stationary idle animations (idle, wave, jump, waiting, review, failed). 1 is normal speed; higher is faster, lower is slower. Does not affect walk/run animations.

codexPet.idleStateWeights.description: Relative chance of each idle animation being picked, e.g. { "wave": 3, "jump": 1 }. States not listed default to a weight of 1; a weight of 0 disables that animation. State names depend on the selected pet's idleStates.

codexPet.jumpCooldown.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between cursor-triggered jumps.

codexPet.petScale.description: Scale multiplier applied to the pet's sprite size.

enumDescriptions: Claude Code, via hooks reporting to ~/.codex-pet/.
Experimental: guess when GitHub Copilot Chat is actively editing files, using an editor-heuristic (VS Code has no public API for this yet). Can misfire on pastes, formatting, or other bulk edits.

codexPet.aiActivitySources.description: Which AI tools the pet plays a busy animation for while they're actively working. Leave empty to disable AI-activity reactions entirely.

codexPet.waitingStaleMinutes.description: How long (minutes) a session can sit in the 'waiting for you' state before it's treated as stale and dropped from the pet's waiting-session list. Only cleans up sessions that crashed after finishing a response but before ending; a normally-waiting session isn't affected by how long a human takes to reply.

codexPet.xpEnabled.description: Give the pet XP and levels based on coding activity (AI tool activity, editor edits, terminal use, git commits, and clicks).

codexPet.petGrowthEnabled.description: Grow the pet's size as it levels up, from petGrowthMinScale at level 1 up to petGrowthMaxScale at petGrowthMaxLevel. Both bounds are multipliers of codexPet.petScale. Requires codexPet.xpEnabled.

codexPet.petGrowthMinScale.description: Size multiplier (of codexPet.petScale) the pet starts at when petGrowthEnabled is on.

codexPet.petGrowthMaxScale.description: Size multiplier (of codexPet.petScale) the pet reaches at petGrowthMaxLevel when petGrowthEnabled is on.

codexPet.petGrowthMaxLevel.description: Level at which the pet reaches petGrowthMaxScale. Growth is linear between level 1 and this level, then caps.
